generate_gmock_classes: generate Google Mock classes for all C++ classes in a header file
generate_gmock_specific_class: generate a Google Mock class for a specific C++ class name from a header
generate_gmock_templated_class: generate a Google Mock class for a templated C++ class with template arguments
generate_gmock_namespaced_class: generate a Google Mock class for a C++ class inside a namespace
generate_gmock_const_methods: generate Google Mock methods including MOCK_CONST_METHOD macros for const virtual functions
